description: List the event categories one hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco) currently has, each with its slug, display label (in the hub's language) and a one-line definition. The slugs are the values for the categories filter of search_events. Typical slugs: party, concert, culture, show, family, food, sport, market, cruise, quiz, tours, other; an event has exactly one.

hub.description: Hub (city): one of hamburg, muenchen, oldenburg, san-francisco; names and abbreviations work too ('Munich', 'MUC', 'HH', 'OL', 'SF', 'SFO', 'Bay Area'), any case.

name: list_categories
